contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP CAE L SEP SEV PERT AVG COSII ; R/ FORTV N REDVC

Silver Coin. Denarius of Septimius Severus (193-211), Reece period 10, possibly issue of 193-194. Obverse description: Bust laureate right with forked beard. Obverse inscription: IMP CAE L SEP SEV PERT AVG COSII. Reverse description: Fortuna standing left holding rudder and cornucopiae. Reverse inscription: FORTV N REDVC. Diameter: 17.3mm, Weight: 2.45gms, die axis: 12
